## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan` | `string` | **yes** | The plan's product id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | The price's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `interval` | `string` | no | The billing interval this price applies to. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `year`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | The addon's price for this plan, in minor units. |
| `tiers` | `array of object` | no | The price tiers, for a tiered addon price. |
| `tiers.up_to_minor` | `integer` | no | The upper bound of the tier. |
| `tiers.unit_amount_minor` | `integer` | no | The price of one unit in the tier, in minor units. |
| `tiers.flat_amount_minor` | `integer` | no | A flat amount for the tier, in minor units. |
